proposal.summary: Adobe After Effects 22.0 (and earlier) and 18.4.2 (and earlier) contain an out-of-bounds read vulnerability that could disclose sensitive memory and be leveraged to bypass mitigations such as ASLR; exploitation requires a victim to open a malicious file.
proposal.cwe_quote: out-of-bounds read vulnerability that could lead to disclosure of sensitive memory.

AV.quote: Exploitation of this issue requires user interaction in that a victim must open a malicious file.

C.quote: out-of-bounds read vulnerability that could lead to disclosure of sensitive memory.

proposal.recommended_next_step: Obtain a malicious sample that triggers the issue, reproduce the out-of-bounds read, identify vulnerable code paths and root cause, and develop/verify a patch or mitigation. Determine exploitability details and assign tracking (CVE) as appropriate.
